licenses.name: MIT License
licenses.summary: Commercial use, modification, distribution, and private use are allowed with copyright and license notices retained.
obligations: Include the license text in distributed copies

licenses.name: Apache License 2.0
licenses.summary: A permissive license with explicit patent rights and notice requirements.
obligations: Include the license and NOTICE when applicable

licenses.name: BSD 2-Clause
licenses.summary: A compact permissive license requiring preservation of copyright and disclaimer notices.

licenses.name: GNU LGPL 2.1
licenses.summary: Allows proprietary surrounding software while modifications to the covered components remain under the LGPL.
obligations: Provide source for modified covered components when distributed

licenses.name: GNU LGPL 3.0
licenses.summary: Weak copyleft focused on changes to the licensed components rather than independent surrounding systems.
obligations: Provide source for modified covered components when distributed
Allow replacement or relinking of the LGPL component

licenses.name: Mozilla Public License 2.0
licenses.summary: File-level copyleft: modified MPL-covered files remain open while separate files may use other licenses.
obligations: Make modified MPL-covered files available when distributed

licenses.name: Eclipse Public License 1.0
licenses.summary: A business-friendly weak-copyleft license with source obligations for distributed modifications.

licenses.name: GNU GPL 2.0
licenses.summary: Distribution of the program or derivatives requires corresponding source under the GPL.

licenses.name: GNU GPL 3.0
licenses.summary: Strong copyleft for distributed software, with patent and anti-tivoization provisions.

licenses.name: GNU GPL 3.0 or later
licenses.summary: GPL 3.0 obligations apply, with the option to follow a later published GPL version.
obligations: License derivatives under a compatible GPL version

licenses.name: GNU AGPL 3.0
licenses.summary: Adds a network-use source offer to GPL-style copyleft, especially relevant to modified hosted services.
obligations: Offer corresponding source to remote users of modified versions

products.name: Odoo Community
products.summary: A broad modular business suite spanning finance, sales, inventory, purchasing, manufacturing, and more.
products.problem: Replaces disconnected back-office tools with a configurable suite and shared operational data.
products.ideal_for: Organizations that want a modular ERP platform and have an implementation partner or internal technical team.
products.edition_boundary: Community modules are LGPL; Odoo Enterprise modules use a separate proprietary license.

products.name: ERPNext
products.summary: A full ERP for accounting, procurement, stock, manufacturing, projects, CRM, and service operations.
products.problem: Gives growing companies one auditable system for finance and operational workflows without per-module licensing.
products.ideal_for: SMBs and mid-market organizations that value flexible workflows and a strong services ecosystem.

products.name: Dolibarr
products.summary: A long-running ERP and CRM for invoicing, accounting, orders, suppliers, inventory, and projects.
products.problem: Provides approachable business administration for companies that need useful modules without a heavyweight ERP program.
products.ideal_for: Small and mid-sized companies, associations, and regional service businesses.

products.name: Bigcapital
products.summary: Modern double-entry accounting and inventory for small and medium businesses.
products.problem: Centralizes invoices, bills, expenses, inventory, and financial statements in a modern web application.
products.ideal_for: SMBs seeking an extensible QuickBooks or Xero-style accounting system.

products.name: Frappe Books
products.summary: Offline-friendly desktop accounting with invoicing, double-entry books, and financial reports.
products.problem: Gives small businesses a focused accounting application that can operate locally without a complex server estate.
products.ideal_for: Small companies and finance teams that prefer desktop-first, offline-capable bookkeeping.

products.name: Lago
products.summary: API-first metering and usage-based billing for complex subscription pricing.
products.problem: Separates billing logic from product code and supports subscriptions, usage, credits, and invoicing.
products.ideal_for: SaaS and platform businesses with evolving or consumption-based pricing.

products.name: Kill Bill
products.summary: Mature subscription billing and payments infrastructure designed for extensibility and scale.
products.problem: Handles complex catalogs, subscriptions, invoices, payments, entitlements, and billing plugins.
products.ideal_for: Mid-market and enterprise subscription businesses with demanding billing requirements.

products.name: Frappe HR
products.summary: HR and payroll covering employee records, recruitment, attendance, leave, performance, and payroll.
products.problem: Connects the employee lifecycle to structured approvals and operational HR workflows.
products.ideal_for: Growing companies that want an extensible HRIS and can localize payroll rules.

products.name: OrangeHRM
products.summary: A long-established HR management system for employee data, leave, time, and core HR processes.
products.problem: Standardizes essential people operations for organizations moving away from spreadsheets.
products.ideal_for: SMBs wanting a recognizable HRIS with an established implementation market.
products.edition_boundary: The Starter application is GPL; advanced paid modules and services are separate.

products.name: Horilla
products.summary: A modern Django HRMS with recruitment, onboarding, attendance, payroll, performance, and assets.
products.problem: Brings broad HR workflows into one customizable web platform.
products.ideal_for: SMBs seeking a modern interface and Python-based customization path.

products.name: OpenCATS
products.summary: A focused applicant tracking system and recruitment CRM for internal and agency hiring teams.
products.problem: Replaces inbox-and-spreadsheet recruiting with candidate records, job pipelines, and search.
products.ideal_for: Budget-conscious recruiting teams that need a focused, established ATS.
products.edition_boundary: Modern OpenCATS code is MPL 2.0; inherited legacy CATS Project code carries its historical license and should be reviewed before redistribution.

products.name: Kimai
products.summary: Multi-user time tracking with teams, projects, approvals, reporting, exports, and invoicing.
products.problem: Creates reliable timesheet and utilization data for payroll, billing, and project control.
products.ideal_for: Professional services, agencies, consultancies, and internal project teams.

products.name: Documenso
products.summary: A modern self-hostable platform for preparing, sending, and signing digital documents.
products.problem: Keeps document-signing workflows and audit data under organizational control.
products.ideal_for: HR, legal, sales, and operations teams replacing proprietary e-signature subscriptions.
products.edition_boundary: Community code is AGPL; commercial plans and enterprise services are offered separately.

products.name: Moodle
products.summary: The established learning management platform for courses, assessment, credentials, and learning ecosystems.
products.problem: Delivers structured training at scale while retaining control of learning data and integrations.
products.ideal_for: Enterprises, education providers, public bodies, and regulated training programs.

products.name: Twenty
products.summary: A modern, extensible CRM designed as an open alternative to Salesforce.
products.problem: Gives technical revenue teams a flexible data model, workflows, and clean pipeline experience.
products.ideal_for: Product-led and technical organizations that want to tailor CRM objects and automation.

products.name: SuiteCRM
products.summary: A mature CRM covering accounts, leads, opportunities, quotes, campaigns, workflows, and service cases.
products.problem: Provides deep traditional CRM functionality without enterprise seat licensing.
products.ideal_for: Mid-market sales organizations needing rich CRM modules and partner-led customization.

products.name: EspoCRM
products.summary: A fast, customizable CRM with sales automation, email, calendars, workflows, and a REST API.
products.problem: Creates a practical 360-degree customer view without a complex enterprise CRM rollout.
products.ideal_for: SMBs and mid-market teams that want a focused CRM and PHP customization ecosystem.

products.name: Frappe CRM
products.summary: A clean, modern CRM built on the extensible Frappe framework.
products.problem: Provides lightweight lead and deal management that can be adapted to specific sales processes.
products.ideal_for: SMBs already using Frappe or wanting a customizable open CRM.

products.name: Easy!Appointments
products.summary: A self-hosted appointment scheduler with services, providers, availability, and calendar synchronization.
products.problem: Lets customers book available time without manual email coordination or per-seat scheduling fees.
products.ideal_for: Service businesses, clinics, consultancies, and customer-facing sales teams.

products.name: Chatwoot
products.summary: Omnichannel customer support across live chat, email, social, messaging, and a help center.
products.problem: Unifies fragmented customer conversations and contact context into a collaborative support workspace.
products.ideal_for: Digital businesses replacing Intercom, Zendesk, or scattered shared inboxes.
products.edition_boundary: The community application is MIT; paid cloud and enterprise capabilities are separate offerings.

products.name: Zammad
products.summary: A polished service desk with email, chat, phone, knowledge base, SLAs, and automation.
products.problem: Provides structured, auditable ticket handling across channels for support and internal service teams.
products.ideal_for: Support desks and IT service teams that need mature workflows and a strong operator UI.

products.name: FreeScout
products.summary: A lightweight help desk and shared mailbox inspired by Help Scout.
products.problem: Turns shared support email into assignable, searchable conversations with team context.
products.ideal_for: Small support teams that want simple deployment and familiar email workflows.

products.name: BookStack
products.summary: An approachable wiki organized around shelves, books, chapters, and pages.
products.problem: Makes internal and customer-facing knowledge easy to structure, own, search, and maintain.
products.ideal_for: Teams that want an opinionated, user-friendly knowledge base with simple administration.

products.name: Fider
products.summary: A public feedback portal for collecting ideas, voting, discussion, and status updates.
products.problem: Creates a transparent, prioritized customer-feedback loop outside support tickets and spreadsheets.
products.ideal_for: Product and customer-success teams that need an open alternative to proprietary feedback boards.

products.name: Mautic
products.summary: A comprehensive marketing automation platform for contacts, segments, campaigns, scoring, email, and journeys.
products.problem: Brings lead nurturing and campaign automation under the company's data and infrastructure control.
products.ideal_for: B2B and lifecycle marketing teams with implementation and deliverability expertise.

products.name: listmonk
products.summary: A high-performance newsletter and mailing-list manager delivered as a compact self-hosted application.
products.problem: Sends high-volume campaigns and manages subscribers without paying a platform tax on every contact.
products.ideal_for: Technical marketing teams that already control their SMTP or transactional email provider.

products.name: Ghost
products.summary: A modern publishing and membership platform for websites, newsletters, and subscriptions.
products.problem: Combines fast editorial publishing, audience ownership, memberships, and email distribution.
products.ideal_for: Content-led businesses, publishers, thought-leadership teams, and membership products.

products.name: Strapi Community
products.summary: A popular headless CMS with customizable content types, APIs, roles, and a large plugin ecosystem.
products.problem: Gives marketing and engineering teams a shared content backend for websites, apps, and digital products.
products.ideal_for: Digital teams that want API-first content management and JavaScript extensibility.
products.edition_boundary: The community core is MIT; enterprise features and cloud services are separately licensed.

products.name: Postiz
products.summary: A modern social media scheduling and publishing platform with collaborative workflows.
products.problem: Centralizes planning and publishing across social channels in a self-hostable workspace.
products.ideal_for: Marketing teams and agencies replacing proprietary social scheduling suites.

products.name: Matomo
products.summary: A mature privacy-oriented web analytics platform with traffic, goals, campaigns, and reporting.
products.problem: Provides Google Analytics-style insight while retaining first-party control of visitor data.
products.ideal_for: Organizations with privacy, compliance, or data-residency requirements.

products.name: Plausible Analytics
products.summary: A lightweight, privacy-focused web analytics product with a deliberately simple reporting experience.
products.problem: Makes essential website analytics understandable while reducing cookie and tracking complexity.
products.ideal_for: Marketing teams that want clear, privacy-friendly website metrics rather than a large analytics suite.

products.name: PostHog FOSS
products.summary: An open product-analytics stack for events, funnels, retention, feature flags, experiments, and session replay.
products.problem: Connects product behavior to experimentation and delivery in a single technical platform.
products.ideal_for: Software companies with engineering support and sophisticated product analytics needs.
products.edition_boundary: This profile points to the FOSS-only repository; PostHog's main monorepo also contains separately licensed enterprise code.

products.name: Metabase OSS
products.summary: Approachable business intelligence for questions, dashboards, SQL, alerts, and embedded analytics.
products.problem: Lets non-technical teams answer recurring data questions without waiting for bespoke analyst reports.
products.ideal_for: SMBs through enterprises seeking fast self-service BI and straightforward deployment.
products.edition_boundary: The open-source edition is AGPL; commercial Metabase editions have a separate license.

products.name: Apache Superset
products.summary: An enterprise-scale data exploration and visualization platform with rich dashboards and SQL tooling.
products.problem: Serves many analytical users and data sources through a scalable, extensible BI layer.
products.ideal_for: Data-mature mid-market and enterprise organizations with platform engineering capacity.

products.name: Redash
products.summary: A well-known SQL-first query, visualization, dashboard, and alerting tool.
products.problem: Gives analysts a simple shared home for database queries and lightweight dashboards.
products.ideal_for: Technical analytics teams that prefer direct SQL workflows and a compact BI surface.

products.name: Lightdash
products.summary: A dbt-native BI layer for governed metrics, self-service exploration, and analytics as code.
products.problem: Turns dbt models into consistent business metrics without duplicating semantic logic in dashboards.
products.ideal_for: Modern data teams already standardized on dbt and software-style analytics workflows.
products.edition_boundary: The open-source core is MIT; the repository contains a separately licensed enterprise directory.

products.name: Apache Airflow
products.summary: The established platform for authoring, scheduling, and monitoring data workflows as code.
products.problem: Makes complex batch data pipelines maintainable, observable, versioned, and recoverable.
products.ideal_for: Data engineering organizations with Python skills and production orchestration needs.

products.name: Meltano
products.summary: A declarative, code-first data-integration engine with a broad Singer connector ecosystem.
products.problem: Standardizes extraction and loading projects while keeping pipeline configuration version-controlled.
products.ideal_for: Lean data teams that prefer composable tooling and code-first deployment.

products.name: OpenMetadata
products.summary: An integrated metadata, discovery, lineage, quality, observability, and governance platform.
products.problem: Creates trusted context around enterprise data so people and systems can discover and govern it.
products.ideal_for: Data-platform teams formalizing ownership, lineage, quality, and AI-ready data context.

products.name: DataHub
products.summary: A scalable metadata platform for discovery, lineage, ownership, governance, and data products.
products.problem: Makes a complex data estate searchable and understandable with continuously ingested metadata.
products.ideal_for: Large data organizations needing a developer-friendly, extensible catalog and metadata graph.

products.name: ClickHouse
products.summary: A high-performance column-oriented database for real-time analytics and large-scale reporting.
products.problem: Runs fast analytical queries across very large event and operational datasets at efficient cost.
products.ideal_for: Engineering and data teams building observability, product analytics, or real-time BI platforms.

products.name: InvenTree
products.summary: A modern inventory and part-management system with stock, purchasing, builds, BOMs, and APIs.
products.problem: Creates accurate parts and stock control for product, manufacturing, and technical operations.
products.ideal_for: Hardware teams, manufacturers, labs, and technical inventory operations.

products.name: OpenBoxes
products.summary: A mature supply-chain and inventory system shaped by healthcare and humanitarian logistics.
products.problem: Tracks inventory, stock movements, shipments, purchasing, and replenishment across facilities.
products.ideal_for: Healthcare, NGOs, multi-site logistics, and operations with traceable stock flows.

products.name: Snipe-IT
products.summary: A focused IT asset and software-license management system with assignments and lifecycle history.
products.problem: Answers who has each asset, where it is, what it cost, and when it must be renewed or replaced.
products.ideal_for: IT and operations teams that need a dependable ITAM register without a full ITSM rollout.

products.name: GLPI
products.summary: A broad IT management suite combining service desk, assets, licenses, CMDB, contracts, and data-center records.
products.problem: Unifies IT service and asset processes with auditable lifecycle and support records.
products.ideal_for: Mid-sized and enterprise IT teams wanting an extensible ITSM and ITAM platform.

products.name: Paperless-ngx
products.summary: A searchable document archive with ingestion, OCR, tagging, correspondents, document types, and workflows.
products.problem: Turns scanned and digital documents into a searchable, categorized operational archive.
products.ideal_for: Back offices and document-heavy teams that need private OCR and retention workflows.

products.name: NetBox
products.summary: The established source of truth for networks, IPAM, data centers, devices, circuits, and infrastructure automation.
products.problem: Replaces network spreadsheets with a structured model and API that can drive automation.
products.ideal_for: Infrastructure and network teams operating non-trivial on-premise or hybrid estates.

products.name: Keycloak
products.summary: Enterprise identity and access management with SSO, OIDC, SAML, federation, MFA, and fine-grained authorization.
products.problem: Centralizes application authentication and access policy instead of rebuilding identity in every system.
products.ideal_for: Organizations standardizing workforce or customer identity across many applications.

products.name: authentik Community
products.summary: A flexible identity provider and authentication layer with modern flows, federation, and application proxies.
products.problem: Adds SSO and policy to internal or customer applications with a modern administrative experience.
products.ideal_for: Technical IT teams seeking an approachable identity platform and reverse-proxy integration.
products.edition_boundary: Core code is MIT; the authentik/enterprise directory is separately licensed.

products.name: Grafana OSS
products.summary: The ubiquitous visualization and observability interface for metrics, logs, traces, and operational data.
products.problem: Creates shared dashboards and alerting across heterogeneous infrastructure and application data sources.
products.ideal_for: Any technical organization operating production systems and shared observability practices.
products.edition_boundary: Grafana OSS is AGPL; enterprise plugins and services are separately licensed.

products.name: Prometheus
products.summary: The cloud-native standard for time-series metrics collection, querying, alerting, and service monitoring.
products.problem: Provides reliable numerical telemetry and alert rules for dynamic infrastructure and applications.
products.ideal_for: Engineering organizations building cloud-native or infrastructure monitoring platforms.

products.name: SigNoz Community
products.summary: An OpenTelemetry-native observability platform unifying logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts.
products.problem: Provides a coherent self-hosted alternative to commercial APM and observability suites.
products.ideal_for: Engineering teams standardizing on OpenTelemetry and wanting one operational interface.
products.edition_boundary: The community platform is open source; enterprise features and managed cloud are separate.

products.name: Wazuh
products.summary: An open security platform for endpoint monitoring, threat detection, log analysis, vulnerability data, and compliance.
products.problem: Consolidates endpoint and security telemetry into actionable detection and compliance workflows.
products.ideal_for: Security teams building a cost-conscious SIEM/XDR and compliance monitoring capability.

products.name: Gitea
products.summary: A fast, lightweight software-development service for Git hosting, reviews, issues, packages, and actions.
products.problem: Provides private source control and collaboration with modest infrastructure requirements.
products.ideal_for: SMBs, internal engineering groups, and regulated teams wanting simple self-hosted Git services.

products.name: Jenkins
products.summary: The established automation server with an enormous plugin ecosystem for CI/CD and operational workflows.
products.problem: Automates repeatable software build, test, release, and infrastructure processes across diverse stacks.
products.ideal_for: Organizations with heterogeneous delivery tooling or substantial existing Jenkins expertise.

products.name: Rocket.Chat
products.summary: A large-scale communications platform for channels, direct messaging, federation, apps, and omnichannel workflows.
products.problem: Keeps mission-critical team and customer communication within controlled infrastructure.
products.ideal_for: Organizations needing extensible, self-hosted real-time communication and integrations.
products.edition_boundary: Community code is open source; paid enterprise capabilities and services are separate.

products.name: Mattermost Community
products.summary: Secure collaboration for technical and operational teams, including messaging, playbooks, and workflow integrations.
products.problem: Supports sensitive team coordination and incident work where data control and extensibility matter.
products.ideal_for: Engineering, operations, public sector, and regulated organizations.
products.edition_boundary: Community source is AGPL with documented exceptions; enterprise features use a commercial license.

products.name: OpenProject
products.summary: Comprehensive project management with planning, agile boards, roadmaps, time, budgets, meetings, and documentation.
products.problem: Gives management one auditable environment for traditional, agile, and hybrid project delivery.
products.ideal_for: Professional services, public bodies, construction, product teams, and PMOs.
products.edition_boundary: Community Edition is GPL; enterprise add-ons and support are separate.

products.name: Plane Community
products.summary: A modern work-management platform for issues, cycles, modules, roadmaps, pages, and product delivery.
products.problem: Provides a contemporary open alternative to Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp.
products.ideal_for: Product and engineering teams that prioritize modern UX and self-hosting.
products.edition_boundary: The Community Edition is AGPL; paid tiers and enterprise features are separate.

products.name: Leantime
products.summary: Goals-focused project management designed for non-project managers and neurodiverse teams.
products.problem: Connects strategy, goals, projects, tasks, time, and retrospectives in an approachable workspace.
products.ideal_for: SMBs, innovation teams, and organizations needing accessible planning and execution.
products.edition_boundary: Core is AGPL; some plugins may use separate enterprise licenses.

products.name: Nextcloud
products.summary: A private collaboration cloud for files, sharing, calendars, contacts, communication, and an extensive app ecosystem.
products.problem: Gives organizations control of collaborative data while replacing multiple proprietary workspace services.
products.ideal_for: Any organization prioritizing data sovereignty, private collaboration, and extensibility.

products.name: Wiki.js
products.summary: A modern, extensible wiki with a polished editor, authentication integrations, search, and multiple storage options.
products.problem: Creates a flexible home for technical and organizational knowledge with enterprise authentication options.
products.ideal_for: Technical teams that want a modern Node-based wiki and broad integration choices.

products.name: Jitsi Meet
products.summary: A widely deployed secure video-conferencing platform for web and mobile meetings.
products.problem: Provides private virtual meetings without requiring every participant to use a proprietary conferencing account.
products.ideal_for: Organizations, public bodies, service providers, and communities needing controlled video meetings.
